text:
nina: hitting flaky duplicate pages from sampleapp when prefetch>1. Seems tied to auth refresh racing with prefetched requests. repro: start sampleapp with prefetch=4 and run a client burst for 30s. sometimes we see same page token processed twice.
owen: which sdk/version?
nina: js-sdk 1.6.2 in our env (node14). py-sdk doesn't reproduce. logs show: [fetch] token=A -> 401 -> refresh -> retry fetch token=A -> duplicate. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/nina-prefetch-repro
devx-bot: rate-limit alert: 429 burst detected (service=api, window=2m)
tao: likely cause: retry middleware replays request before refreshed headers are attached. quick client fix: make token refresh a shared promise (serialize) so inflight retries pick up new token. server mitigation: add page-cursor idempotency to ignore duplicate cursors within short window.
lin: can we add an integration test in sdk-js that simulates 401 on prefetched page and assert only one page delivered? also document onboarding note: "If you see early 429s, lower prefetch to 1 or upgrade to js-sdk >=1.6.4"
